verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de lets businesses submit documents, manage signers, and run digital notarization, with AI-detected signature fields and webhook status updates. A legal-ops lead could therefore upload an already-drafted resolution and collect notarized signatures on it remotely. Nothing in the evidence covers drafting or templating board consents and resolutions, or a board-approval workflow as such. Missing for 10: resolution/consent drafting or templates, board-member approval routing and tracking, simple e-signature approvals without notarization, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
